newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Trade picks up on Saudi stock market in the week.
newsitem.headline: Trade picks up on Saudi stock market in the week.

text.p: The value and volume of shares traded on the Saudi stock market picked up last week, official figures released on Sunday showed.

The Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency (SAMA) said turnover nearly doubled to 4.34 million shares worth 745.4 million riyals ($198.8 million) in the week to Thursday from 2.2 million shares worth 463.5 million riyals a week earlier.
SAMA, quoted by the official Saudi Press Agency, said shares of 60 firms were traded in the week. Prices of 41 rose, 15 dropped and four were unchanged.
The agency said the services sector dominated trading, with 1.5 million shares worth 108.7 million riyals changing hands.
